name: Sugar Pie
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: ¼ cup cornstarch (flour can work if cornstarch is unavailable)
Cinnamon or nutmeg to sprinkle on top of pie (optional)

steps: In large saucepan, simmer milk without boiling.
Dissolve sugar, cornstarch and butter into milk. Stir gently and allow to thicken for about 5 minutes.
Pour mixture into pie crust and gently transfer into oven. Bake for about 22 minutes.
Optionally engage broiler for a few minutes to caramelize the top of the pie.

culture.text: Sugar pie is a traditional American pie known by several other names, including "Desperation Pie" (due to low ingredient count) and "Sugar Cream Pie". Under the last name, it is the official pie of the state of Indiana.
